items.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report 2026 Q3: More swarms, fewer giants

items.title: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge
items.summary: We are launching a PHP Capture the Flag challenge integrated with our Bug Bounty program to test our WAF protections. Security researchers are invited to bypass our defenses and capture the flag to help make the Internet safer.

items.title: What took the Internet offline in Q3 2026
items.summary: An examination of global Internet disruptions observed by Cloudflare Radar during the third quarter of 2026. This review analyzes how power failures, natural disasters, and government shutdowns impacted network connectivity and traffic.

items.title: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning
items.summary: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. We rebuilt our cache architecture in Pingora to coordinate partial fetches automatically, cutting R2 p99 latency in half.
